title: Phantom / Vampire drain solution: works using 12V battery tender

author: ElectricalGuru
defect_topic: Workaround using external battery tender to prevent continuous HV wake cycles
topic: Workaround using external battery tender to prevent continuous HV wake cycles
raw_quote: Hooked a CTEK 12V smart battery tender to the auxiliary terminal posts under the front cowl. Presto: phantom vampire drain dropped from 2.5% per night down to 0.3%! Why? Because the Rivian's main computer wakes up 8 to 12 times a night whenever the 12V voltage drops below 12.2V, activating the high-voltage contactors and cooling pumps just to recharge the 12V battery. Keeping the 12V float-charged tricks the vehicle into staying in deep sleep. Ridiculous that owners have to plug in a battery tender on an $80k EV to stop it eating its own battery.
